# Rohith Illuri

> Self-taught developer. Portfolio is a single static HTML page with a dark antiquarian aesthetic — no frameworks, no build step.

## About

Rohith is a self-taught developer who likes shipping things, performance work, and clean UIs. Outside of code: heavy lifting, AC/DC at unreasonable volumes, and Tarantino films.

## Site

Deployed at https://rohithilluri.github.io — a single `site/index.html` file. Pure HTML/CSS/JS, no React, no bundler.

Features: living-painting gallery (Wikimedia Commons), motion poster wall, orchestral background music (Tone.js generative synthesis, gesture-gated), contact section.

## Sections

- Hero: name, tagline, nav
- Living Paintings: classical art that reacts to scroll/hover
- Motion Posters: film posters with animated overlays
- Music: embedded audio toggle (Tone.js orchestral BGM)
- Contact: email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Twitter

## Tech

Static HTML/CSS/JS · Tone.js (generative audio) · Google Fonts (Cinzel, EB Garamond) · Wikimedia Commons (paintings)
